title: Design a Movie Ticket Booking System
description: Model movies, shows, seats, bookings, and seat locking.

data.text: Design a movie ticket booking system. A movie has multiple shows. Each show has a seat map. Users select seats and book. Prevent double-booking.
Seat is a value object with row, number, and status. Show holds a seat map. Booking links a user to selected seats for a show.

data.title: Seat, Show, and Booking
Why internal set on SeatStatus?
data.text: Seat.Status should only change through Show methods. internal set allows the property to be set inside the same assembly (e.g., by a BookingService) but not from arbitrary callers.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Seat is a value object keyed by row and number
Show owns the seat map and state transitions
data.takeaway: Movie booking is fundamentally a seat-state problem. Keep seat state transitions inside Show to prevent race conditions and invalid state changes.
